question: The Supreme Court on 28 January 2022, quashed the ________ Legislative Assembly's resolution of 5 July 2021, which suspended 12 BJP MLAs for a period of one year for alleged disorderly behaviour in the House.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Maharashtra**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 12 Bhartiya Janata Party (BJP) MLAs were suspended from the Maharashtra assembly** for misbehaving with officer Bhaskar Jadhav in the speaker's chamber.**
 
• These **MLAs moved to Supreme Court** to challenge this **one-year suspension in July 2021.**
 
• **Supreme Court quashed this suspension** thinking of the citizens and the work that will suffer.
 
• **The 12 MLAs were: Harish Pimpale, Sanjay Kute, Yogesh Sagar, Ashish Shelar, Jay Kumar Rawat, Abhimanyu Pawar, Girish Mahajan, Bunty Bhandia, Ram Satpute, Atul Bhatkhalkar, Narayan Kuche, and Parag Alavani**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ **

 
• Maharashtra:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Eknath Shinde.
 
• Governor - Ramesh bais.
 
• Number of Districts - 36.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 48.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 19.
 
• **Legislative Assembly seats** - 288
 
• **Legislative Council seats** - 78
 
• State Animal - Indian giant squirrel.
 
• State Bird - Yellow-footed green pigeon.
 
• National Parks - Chandoli National Park, Gugamal National Park, Nawegaon National Park, Pench National Park, Sanjay Gandhi (Borivilli) National Park, Tadoba National Park.
 
• Dams - Koyna Dam (Koyna River), Jayakwadi Dam (Godavari River), Wilson Dam (Pravara River), Vaitarna Dam (Vaitarna River), Mula Dam (Mula River).
